news.title: Saudi National Team Continues Training Camp in Doha During FIFA International Window
news.og_title: Saudi National Team Continues Training Camp in Doha During FIFA International Window
news.og_desc:
Doha, November 10, 2026, SPA -- The Saudi national football team continued its training sessions this evening in the Qatari capital, Doha, as part of its preparatory camp during the FIFA international window ahead of upcoming competitions.
    The team held its training session under the supervision of the technical staff. The session began with warm-up exercises, followed by small-sided drills and tactical exercises focused on high pressing, before concluding with a full-pitch tactical match.
    The team will resume training tomorrow, Wednesday, at 6:30 p.m., with the session closed to the media.
    -- SPA
